chokepoints.name: Bab al-Mandab
chokepoints.note: Between Yemen and Djibouti / Eritrea; Red Sea gateway.

chokepoints.name: Suez Canal

chokepoints.name: Panama Canal

chokepoints.name: Strait of Dover

chokepoints.name: Taiwan Strait

method: Hand-curated regional snapshot. The Port Index download URL (theportindex.online/data) 404s as of 2026-11-17 and msi.nga.mil returns HTTP 503, so no bulk WPI file could be fetched; each coordinate below was pinned from a verified source (see per-entry sources) and never invented. Refresh: re-fetch WPI / The Port Index when it serves again, verify each coordinate, bump version, update the pinning tests in records.test.mjs.

ports.name: Cape May
ports.note: Small-craft harbor at the Cape May Canal / Cape May Inlet; no commercial deep-draft channel. Coordinate is the harbor centroid (Canyon Club 38.95377,-74.90162; Cape May Marina 38.94766,-74.91346).
sources: 46 CFR 7.40 (Cape May Inlet East Jetty Light 38.93,-74.8567)

ports.name: Atlantic City

ports.name: Philadelphia
ports.note: Delaware River main channel maintained at 45 ft (13.7 m) from Allegheny Ave to the mouth of Delaware Bay.

ports.name: Wilmington
ports.note: Port of Wilmington, Delaware River / Christina River, 65 mi from the Atlantic; channel 38 ft (11.6 m), turning basin 38 ft opposite Wilmington Marine Terminal. Coordinate is the Wilmington Marine Terminal tide station. UN/LOCODE unverified — USILM is Wilmington NC, do not use.
sources: USACE Philadelphia District Wilmington Harbor fact sheet 2026-04-15

sources: USACE Baltimore District 50-foot project fact sheet
